title: iGlucose® Remote Patient Monitoring Device as an Adjunct to Routine Glucose Meter Devices for Glycemic Management and Control in Gestational Diabetes
official: iGlucose® Remote Patient Monitoring Device as an Adjunct to Routine Glucose Meter Devices for Glycemic Management and Control in Gestational Diabetes: a Pilot Randomized, Controlled Trial
summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate whether automation of glucose monitoring data to facilitate the total number of recommended and completed SMBG checks improve clinical outcomes for women living with gestational and type 2 diabetes during pregnancy? This is a RCT
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* All patients \>/= women 18 years of age with gestational diabetes or type 2 diabetes during pregnancy and identified by the research team and consented before 30.6 weeks.
* Non-anomalous singletons
* Ability to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria

* Patients with Type 1 diabetes
* Patients with fetal major congenital abnormalities
* Patients identified/referred after 30.6 weeks
